components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The main commit or open action, marked in route gold.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1.1rem; border: 1px solid var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); color: #1a211b; font: 600 0.9rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: color .16s ease, background-color .16s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #e3c881; border-color: #e3c881; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #c8a85f; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A supporting viewer action on an evergreen surface.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--route-line, #304238); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--route-bg-raised, #17211d); color: var(--route-text, #e8eadf); font: 500 0.85rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: color .16s ease, background-color .16s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--route-surface, #1c2923); border-color: #506454; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { background: var(--route-bg, #111a17); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Compact navigation with one gold active destination.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 .8rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--route-muted, #aeb9ae); font: 500 .8rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: color .16s ease, background-color .16s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--route-text, #e8eadf); background: var(--route-bg-raised, #17211d); border-color: var(--route-line, #304238); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active { color: #1a211b; background: var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); border-color: var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-active:hover { color: #1a211b; background: #e3c881; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The directory search field, sized for comfortable phone use.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="Search subjects and notes" aria-label="Search subjects and notes">
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 .85rem; border: 1px solid var(--route-line, #304238); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--route-bg, #111a17); color: var(--route-text, #e8eadf); font: 400 .9rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: #9aa89c; opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-visible { border-color: var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); outline: 2px solid rgba(217,184,110,.16); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Directory Row
components.description: A scan-friendly folder or note row with a clear selected state.
components.css: .ds-tree-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: .55rem .7rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #d5ddd4; text-align: left; font: 400 .88rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: background-color .16s ease; } .ds-tree-row:hover { color: var(--route-text, #e8eadf); background: #1a2720; } .ds-tree-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tree-selected { color: var(--route-text, #e8eadf); background: #28352b; border-color: var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); } .ds-tree-badge { color: var(--route-muted, #aeb9ae); font-size: .72rem; }

components.name: Information Card
components.description: A quiet raised surface for supporting information or submissions.
components.html:
Study resources

Browse notes by stream, subject, and topic.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--route-line, #304238); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--route-bg-raised, #17211d); color: var(--route-text, #e8eadf); font: 400 .9rem/1.6 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: .35rem 0 0; color: var(--route-muted, #aeb9ae); }

components.name: Mobile Pane Tab
components.description: Switches between directory and document preview on phones.
components.css: .ds-mobile-tab { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 .8rem; border: 1px solid var(--route-line, #304238); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--route-bg-raised, #17211d); color: var(--route-muted, #aeb9ae); font: 500 .82rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-mobile-tab:hover { color: var(--route-text, #e8eadf); } .ds-mobile-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mobile-tab-active { border-color: var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); background: var(--route-gold, #d9b86e); color: #1a211b; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
ISC.exe should feel like a quiet, dependable route through a large study collection. The evergreen ground and raised surfaces keep attention on the subject and resource rows; soft ivory carries the content, while a single warm-gold mark makes the current route or primary action easy to find. The interface is precise and calm, with measured rows and clear alignment rather than a hero-first or control-panel mood.

Use the existing identity and product language. Keep the directory useful and content-led across desktop and phone layouts. Dark is the default and only visual mode; theme choices may shift the dark hue, but must remain dark.
keyCharacteristics: Dark evergreen foundation with raised, distinct reading surfaces.
Warm gold identifies the active route, selection, focus, and primary action.
Terse hierarchy, aligned rows, and restrained surface decoration.
Responsive directory and document preview flow.

rules.name: The One Gold Marker Rule
rules.body: Keep route gold focused on active, selected, focused, or primary elements; use sage and surface shifts for ordinary hierarchy.

rules.name: The Dark-Only Rule
rules.body: All defaults and user-selectable UI themes stay dark. Never introduce a white or light mode.

rules.name: The Plain Case Rule
rules.body: Prefer sentence case and normal tracking for labels. Avoid turning routine navigation or metadata into widely tracked all-caps decoration.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Resting navigation, buttons, and content rows use tonal and border differences rather than glow or floating shadows.

dos: Do keep the default and every selectable UI palette dark.
Do use gold for active routes, selected items, focus, and primary actions.
Do preserve clear row alignment and the existing directory-to-preview flow at every viewport.
Do keep main phone controls at least 44px high.
donts: Don't add a white or light mode.
Don't use neon glow, glass blur, gradient text, or floating shadows as the default surface treatment.
Don't use the gold accent as a broad background; its signal depends on selective use.
Don't alter the product name, logo, study content, or existing resource actions as part of visual styling.
